posts.trend: India Housing Sales Up 3% in Q3 2026 to 1 Lakh Units: Anarock
posts.context: The pressure to buy a home peaks at thirty, but the product being sold is increasingly imaginary.
posts.angle: The brochure is selling a high-status lifestyle, but the actual square footage is a claustrophobic box.
slides: The brochure has a virtual infinity pool. The carpet area is 340 square feet.

Brochure: "Luxury 1BHK in an upcoming hub."
Reality: 42 km from your office.

Brochure: "Smart home enabled."
Reality: A lock that opens into the gas stove.

You are thirty-three.

You are buying a drawing of a building.
posts.caption: Send this to the colleague who has three tabs of real estate listings open during the standup.
